name: Retascón (Spain)
description: Blue field with a hoist part of the bars of Aragon with a pointed edge fimbriated white, charged with a crowned yellow letter R.
history: Municipal flag of Retascón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: pointed stripe along the hoist bearing yellow and red bars and edged white
bars on the hoist stripe and crowned letter R
